capabilities.description: Legge runner, scheduler, lease, Browser Agent e requisiti H24 senza affermare continuità quando cron o Chrome non sono disponibili.
Sincronizza una slice bounded del sito nel twin operativo privato, con provenienza e senza corpi pagina, ordini o dati cliente.
Interroga entità compatte del twin operativo distinguendo fatti WordPress, API, Browser live, derivazioni e raccomandazioni.
Normalizza una snapshot di metriche social ottenuta da API, webhook, import o Browser Agent, con sorgente esplicita e senza credenziali.
Calcola trend, engagement, condivisioni, salvataggi, completamento e viralità su snapshot social realmente osservate.
Ordina opportunità da twin, metriche social e segnali espliciti tramite formula deterministica con confidence, effort, urgenza ed evidenza.
Esegue una scansione bounded del sito e genera alert soltanto per cambiamenti o degradi osservati.
Rileva in modo zero-config le integrazioni MCP/native disponibili, senza avviare processi né cambiare installazione.
Filesystem locale sandboxato: stat, read, list e search soltanto dentro le radici WordPress/PR STUDIO.
Scrittura filesystem atomica e sandboxata; supporta write, replace esatto e mkdir senza delete.
Git locale read-only senza shell: status, log, diff, show, branches e remotes su repository dentro le radici consentite.
SQLite locale read-only con query SELECT/WITH/EXPLAIN/PRAGMA allowlisted; sidecar opzionale se il driver PHP manca.
PostgreSQL restricted/read-only quando DATABASE_URI esiste già nell ambiente; nessuna nuova credenziale viene richiesta.
WP-CLI locale read-only con allowlist deterministica; nessuna stringa shell arbitraria.
Ottimizza immagini locali tramite WP_Image_Editor con resize/quality e output verificato, senza servizi esterni.
Legge PDF locali tramite pdftotext quando presente; fallback disponibile al sidecar PDF MCP fissato.
Converte documenti locali con Pandoc già installato; input/output restano dentro le radici consentite.
Avvia on-demand un sidecar MCP fissato e restituisce tools/list; nessun sidecar parte al bootstrap.
Chiama soltanto la lane read-only di un sidecar MCP fissato, con timeout e terminazione forzata del processo.
Chiama esplicitamente un tool di un sidecar MCP fissato. Operazione controllata perché alcuni sidecar possono mutare file o stato.
Scansione accessibilità WCAG tramite sidecar axe-core/Playwright fissato, avviato solo su richiesta e senza account/API key.
Render Mermaid in SVG/PNG tramite sidecar fissato; nessun servizio cloud o account richiesto.
Audit dipendenze tramite sidecar OSV.dev keyless fissato: singolo pacchetto, batch, advisory o lista ecosistemi.
Lettura/search/evidence PDF locale tramite il sidecar @sylphx/pdf-reader-mcp fissato, con path locali sandboxati.
Compatibilità Local by Flywheel via local-wp-mcp fissato con WPCLI/MYSQL/FS writes forzati a false.
Persist, list, evaluate or remove strategic goals and constraints used by the Director.
Resolve contradictory facts by source authority, freshness and confidence.
Persist a bounded managerial decision journal with rationale, alternatives, evidence and expected outcome.
Track baseline, intervention, observation window and measured outcome for learning.
Compute deterministic contribution margin from revenue and bounded variable-cost inputs.
Run bounded non-executing linear what-if scenarios over supplied business metrics.
Traverse supplied semantic relations and quantify bounded downstream dependency impact.
Calculate reorder point, safety stock, stockout and overstock heuristics from supplied demand data.
Evaluate a two-variant experiment with confidence interval, significance and guardrails.
Calibrate recommendation confidence from predicted versus measured impact.
Mark recommendations valid or stale from evidence age and bounded TTL.
Persist one explicit structured Sequential Thinking note; optionally federate to the pinned official MCP server. Hidden chain-of-thought is never stored.
Read one explicit bounded Sequential Thinking session.
Inspect Sequential Thinking native/sidecar readiness and bounded-session metrics.
Search verified learned procedures and known failed paths before retrying a task.
Read a verified procedural skill and its progressive-disclosure SKILL.md.
Inspect procedural-skill learning, reuse, validity and staleness metrics.
Expire a learned procedure after an environment/application change while preserving history.
Conservatively curate verified procedural memory: surface stale/failed-only/overlapping skills and optionally archive without deleting history or auto-merging variants.
Configure a bounded SerpBear endpoint/domain/GSC property and store the API key in the encrypted Secrets Vault.
Inspect SerpBear configuration and durable watcher status without exposing the API secret.
Read configured SerpBear keywords and exact latest SERP positions via authenticated API.
Trigger the documented SerpBear POST /api/cron refresh only when refresh_all=true.
Create a durable keyword watcher with first-page and target-position milestones and consecutive confirmations.
Run one bounded watcher check: exact SerpBear positions plus separate GSC query/page evidence.
List durable rank watchers without deleting history.
Read one rank watcher, keyword milestones and bounded history.
Cancel future checks while preserving watcher history and evidence.
Build a bounded symbol/hash repo map for context-efficient code analysis inside the PR STUDIO plugin root.
Run fixed anti-crash profiles: PHP lint, JSON validation and semantic no-stub scan. No arbitrary shell string is accepted.
Run an allowlisted argv-based engineering operation (php_version, php_lint, json_validate, test_matrix, repo_map); arbitrary Bash is not exposed.
Inspect bounded engineering-workbench limits and safe operation catalogue.
Create sharded durable daily watches for every keyword returned by the configured SerpBear domain, preserving first-page and target-position milestones.
Richiede una nuova scansione tramite la UI Search Console autenticata dopo URL Inspection, selezionando e verificando la proprietà esatta e accettando il successo solo dopo conferma UI osservabile.

Modifica deterministica di un post/pagina WordPress esistente con optimistic lock, anchor-count, revisione, idempotenza, readback DB e verifica pubblica opzionale; evita l’editing Gutenberg per patch testuali precise.
Resolve the authoritative WordPress render source for a public URL before mutation: front page/post, FSE template/template-part, theme files and page-specific stylesheet.
Persist and govern head-keyword campaigns (vino, ricette, ristoranti, Sicilia, bar), current metrics, satellites, do-not-do constraints and next best action.
Maintain a binding from keyword+intent to one dominant URL and reject silent competing primaries unless an explicit migration is requested.
Persist an observed SERP snapshot, classify intent/content types, hash it, cache it and avoid re-observing unchanged SERPs until TTL expiry.
Compile a deterministic editorial contract from campaign, dominant URL, SERP intent, entities, products, links, missing competitor topics, schema and forbidden overlap.
Create and publish WordPress content server-side with idempotency, taxonomy/Rank Math/schema, DB readback and nonblocking public/sitemap evidence.
Persist factual claim evidence with source authority, confidence and expiry for reporting; stale or missing evidence never authorizes or vetoes publishing.
Build a bounded internal-link authority graph with incoming/outgoing counts, orphan evidence and pillar-support inputs for editorial planning.
Resolve or persist a decision for competing same-intent URLs using KEEP, REFRESH, MERGE, REDIRECT, NOINDEX, RETARGET or DIFFERENTIATE rather than publishing another duplicate.
Track every new URL from public HTTP/indexability/canonical through GSC/SERP milestones and retain 180 observations before recommending refresh or diagnosis.
Rank existing pages for refresh using ranking opportunity, impressions, business/campaign importance and modification risk.
Compile and validate bounded editorial JSON-LD for Article, Recipe and BreadcrumbList before publication.
Validate editorial media assets and ALT metadata, optionally applying a bounded missing ALT update with persisted readback.
Maintain deduplicated structured Restaurant/Bar/Winery/Producer/Local entities with provenance and freshness for scalable directory hubs.
Maintain a bounded SEO outreach/relationship CRM for producers, wineries, restaurants, bars, associations, events and editorial partners.
Aggregate WooCommerce order/product/category demand above a privacy threshold into original first-party editorial insight candidates without exposing personal data.
